name: srichand-advisor-db
description: Prototype database, MCP server and knowledge base for the Srichand AI beauty advisor (LINE OA).

scripts.data:all: python3 scripts/01_build_catalog.py && python3 scripts/02_build_sets.py && python3 scripts/03_build_knowledge.py && python3 scripts/04_generate_mock.py && python3 scripts/05_meta.py && bun run db/build.ts
scripts.mcp:restart: (lsof -ti tcp:${PORT:-8787} -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; bun run mcp-server/src/http.ts)
